summary: CNFinance Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 with the SEC. The filing is a routine disclosure requirement for a foreign private issuer and does not involve any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 simply confirms the annual report is available and provides contact information for requesting a hard copy. This is a standard current report with no event-driven implications.
